prompt: When a Linear issue is closed, fetch all its comments using cursor pagination and post a single digest message to a Discord channel.

plan.summary: When a Linear issue transitions to closed state, fetch all its comments via cursor pagination and post a formatted digest to a Discord channel.

source.docsQuery: Linear issue closed webhook payload fields cursor pagination comments

target.docsQuery: Discord API post message to channel webhook payload content

fieldMapping.note: Discord channel ID where digest will be posted
Issue title as the opening line of the digest
Issue description appended to the digest content
Author name for each comment in the digest
Comment body text for each comment in the digest
Cursor for the next page of comments (pagination)
Boolean flag to determine if another page exists

assumptions: The Linear webhook payload includes the issue ID and a comments connection with edges/nodes structure.
The Discord integration uses a webhook or bot token to post messages to a specific channel ID.
Cursor pagination follows the standard Relay cursor format (hasNextPage, endCursor) in the comments field.
The user will provide the target Discord channel ID as a static configuration value.
The digest message will be a concatenated string of the issue metadata and all comment author/content pairs.

sources.title: Linear Webhooks: Complete Guide with Payload Examples [2025]

data.title: Add user authentication to API endpoints

notes: Webhook payload includes 'action' field; for issue closed, action='update' and data.stateId corresponds to closed state.
To get comments, connector must call Linear GraphQL API using issue.id from webhook data.
Linear webhook signature verification required using HMAC-SHA256 with secret from webhook creation.
Linear-Timestamp header and webhookTimestamp field can be used for replay attack protection.
Comments are not included in webhook payload; must be fetched via separate API call with pagination.
